scope: Four residual non-CAGR V8.2 contradictions, symmetric before labels, and selected neighboring Supported labels whose metric/window/quantifier was added. This is not a complete second adjudication of every atom.
reviewer: Codex requirements subagent; independent source-span review, not human annotation
purpose: Prevent both false contradiction labels and false support labels. Proposals are not an improved verifier outcome or a claim of perfect scores.
core_conclusion: Retain AMD explicit EV/EBITDA range error. Propose Unsupported for NVDA generic multiples, unspecified EBITDA-growth ranking, and Intel remain-higher claim because the audit inserted a metric, interval or universal qualifier. Do not turn ambiguity into Supported.

NVDA_2025_peer_mean_counterexample.warning: Illustrates benchmark ambiguity only; does not assert that the writer intended a peer mean.

generalizable_deterministic_rules: Resolve metric, units, focal entity, comparator or aggregation rule, financial period, actual/forecast and operator from the source span plus explicit context before arithmetic. Missing fields produce an unresolved/Unsupported status, not a guessed replacement.

Never map generic valuation multiples or PE into EV/EBITDA merely because only that peer table exists. Never turn relative to peers into greater than every peer unless each/both/all is entailed by the original.

Use a common displayed year only when the claim explicitly names that year or an explicit current/latest contextual rule applies. Record the rule. Same fiscal-year label does not establish identical fiscal-end dates, and a2027 peer projection must not be silently treated as an actual observation.

For growth, distinguish rate versus dollar increase, YoY versus CAGR, and exact endpoints/elapsed years. Refuse unsigned percent comparisons with zero/negative bases; flag low-base effects. Calculate competing interpretations for diagnosis without selecting the most convenient one.

Universal comparisons require a true universal expression such as every year/throughout2022-2025/always. Remain, generally, high, superior and in recent years are not interchangeable with universally or consistently. A counterexample disproves an actual universal claim, not an invented one.

Numeric range checks are safe with an explicit interval and understood rounding. A vague recent-years range may be contradicted only when the violation survives reasonable contiguous recent windows. Do not call57.1197 versus near60 an error; do retain17.9136/38.2717 versus mid40s.

Keep original assertions and diagnostics. If adding an explicit dated factual replacement, mark it as a new narrower claim with its own evidence and explain lost coverage. Do not let it retroactively certify the broader original sentence.

Apply any erratum consistently before and after, including neighboring Supported labels, save new versioned adjudication files, preserve originals and distinguish measurement changes from actual verifier improvements. Recompute all scorecards only after this review is accepted.
